fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Type of user interaction with the item

fields.name: category_code
fields.description: Dot-separated category path, e.g. 'electronics.smartphone'. Feeds the TF-IDF content-based model. Can be blank even when category_id is present (see row 2, 7).

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Product brand. Feeds the TF-IDF content-based model. Can be blank even when category_code is present (see row 4).

fields.name: price
fields.description: Product price at time of event. Guaranteed > 0 by the cleaning pipeline.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user performing the event

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Groups events into a single browsing session. Required for real-time re-ranking; every row in this cleaned dataset has one.
